```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
```

```{r}
sex_unintent <- read.csv("../data/wonder_opioid/Sex-Unintentional.csv")
sex_intent   <- read.csv("../data/wonder_opioid/Sex-Intentional.csv")
census_region_all <- read.csv("../data/wonder_opioid/Census-Region-Drug-Overdose.csv")

# restrict to 2000–2020 and make numeric
clean_years <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      Year = as.numeric(Year),
      Deaths = as.numeric(Deaths),
      Population = as.numeric(Population)
    ) %>%
    filter(Year >= 2000, Year <= 2020)
}

sex_unintent <- clean_years(sex_unintent)
sex_intent   <- clean_years(sex_intent)
census_region_all <- clean_years(census_region_all)

# combine opioid files
opioid_sex <- bind_rows(
  sex_unintent %>% mutate(Intent = "Unintentional"),
  sex_intent   %>% mutate(Intent = "Intentional")
)
```

```{r}
year_focus <- 2020

suicide_by_sex <- opioid_sex %>%
  filter(Intent == "Intentional", Year == year_focus) %>%
  group_by(Sex) %>%
  summarise(
    deaths = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE),
    pop = sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
    rate = 100000 * deaths / pop,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(prop_within_intent = deaths / sum(deaths))

suicide_by_sex
```


```{r}
ggplot(suicide_by_sex, aes(x = Sex, y = deaths, fill = Sex)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Male" = "#007acc",
    "Female" = "#ff8ab8"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Intentional (suicide) opioid deaths by sex,", year_focus),
    x = "Sex",
    y = "Deaths"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```


```{r}
intent_compare <- opioid_sex %>%
  filter(Year == year_focus) %>%
  group_by(Intent) %>%
  summarise(
    deaths = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE),
    pop = sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
    rate = 100000 * deaths / pop,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(prop_of_total = deaths / sum(deaths))

intent_compare
```
```{r}
opioid_trend <- opioid_sex %>%
  group_by(Year, Intent, Sex) %>%
  summarise(
    deaths = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE),
    pop = sum(Population, na.rm = TRUE),
    rate = 100000 * deaths / pop,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height= 6}
ggplot() +
  # unintentional (solid, thicker)
  geom_line(
    data = opioid_trend %>% filter(Intent == "Unintentional"),
    aes(x = Year, y = rate, color = Sex, linetype = "Unintentional"),
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  # intentional (dotted, thinner)
  geom_line(
    data = opioid_trend %>% filter(Intent == "Intentional"),
    aes(x = Year, y = rate, color = Sex, linetype = "Intentional"),
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Male" = "#007acc",
    "Female" = "#ff8ab8"
  )) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(
    "Intentional" = "dotted",
    "Unintentional" = "solid"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Opioid death rates 2000–2020 by Sex and Intent",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Deaths per 100k",
    color = "Sex",
    linetype = "Intent"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
```{r}
region_trend <- census_region_all %>%
  mutate(
    rate  = Age.Adjusted.Rate,
    lower = Age.Adjusted.Rate.Lower.95..Confidence.Interval,
    upper = Age.Adjusted.Rate.Upper.95..Confidence.Interval
  ) %>%
  group_by(Census.Region, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    rate  = first(rate),
    lower = first(lower),
    upper = first(upper),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6}
all_drug_census <- ggplot(region_trend,
                          aes(x = Year, y = rate, color = Census.Region)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = Census.Region),
              alpha = 0.12, color = NA) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ Census.Region, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "All-drug age-adjusted overdose rates 2000–2020 by Census Region",
    y = "Age-adjusted deaths per 100k",
    x = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_discrete(guide = "none")  # hide separate fill legend

all_drug_census
```

```{r}
region_growth <- region_trend %>%
  group_by(Census.Region) %>%
  arrange(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    rate_2000 = rate[Year == 2000],
    rate_2020 = rate[Year == 2020],
    pct_change = 100 * (rate_2020 - rate_2000) / rate_2000,
    growth_factor = rate_2020 / rate_2000,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

region_growth
```

```{r}
census_region_opioid <- read.csv("../data/wonder_opioid/Census-Region-Sex.csv")

census_region_opioid <- census_region_opioid %>%
  mutate(
    Year = as.numeric(Year),
    Deaths = as.numeric(Deaths),
    Population = as.numeric(Population),
    rate_aa  = Age.Adjusted.Rate,
    lower_aa = Age.Adjusted.Rate.Lower.95..Confidence.Interval,
    upper_aa = Age.Adjusted.Rate.Upper.95..Confidence.Interval
  ) %>%
  filter(Year >= 2000, Year <= 2020)

opioid_region <- census_region_opioid %>%
  group_by(Census.Region, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    rate  = weighted.mean(rate_aa,  w = Population, na.rm = TRUE),
    lower = weighted.mean(lower_aa, w = Population, na.rm = TRUE),
    upper = weighted.mean(upper_aa, w = Population, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6}
opioid_census_region <- ggplot(opioid_region,
                               aes(x = Year, y = rate, color = Census.Region)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper, fill = Census.Region),
              alpha = 0.12, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ Census.Region, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Opioid age-adjusted death rates 2000–2020 by Census Region",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Age-adjusted deaths per 100k",
    color = "Census Region"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_discrete(guide = "none")

opioid_census_region
```

```{r}
opioid_region_growth <- opioid_region %>%
```

```{r}
all_causes <- read.csv("../data/wonder_opioid/all-causes-of-death.csv")

allcause_df <- all_causes %>%
  mutate(
    Year = as.numeric(Year),
    Deaths = as.numeric(Deaths),
    Population = as.numeric(Population),
    rate_aa  = Age.Adjusted.Rate,
    lower_aa = Age.Adjusted.Rate.Lower.95..Confidence.Interval,
    upper_aa = Age.Adjusted.Rate.Upper.95..Confidence.Interval
  ) %>%
  filter(Year >= 2000, Year <= 2020)

allcause_region <- allcause_df %>%
  group_by(Census.Region, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    rate  = first(rate_aa),
    lower = first(lower_aa),
    upper = first(upper_aa),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```



```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
scale_factor <- max(allcause_region$rate, na.rm = TRUE) /
                max(bind_rows(opioid_region, region_trend)$rate, na.rm = TRUE)

combined_ci <- bind_rows(
  opioid_region %>%
    mutate(Type = "Opioid"),
  region_trend %>%
    mutate(Type = "All-drug"),
  allcause_region %>%
    mutate(
      Type = "All-cause",
      rate  = rate  / scale_factor,
      lower = lower / scale_factor,
      upper = upper / scale_factor
    )
)

opioid_vs_drug_vs_all <- ggplot(combined_ci,
                                aes(x = Year, y = rate, color = Type, fill = Type)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ Census.Region, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Opioid / All-drug age-adjusted deaths per 100k",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      ~ . * scale_factor,
      name = "All-cause age-adjusted deaths per 100k"
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Opioid"    = "#007acc",
    "All-drug"  = "#00b050",
    "All-cause" = "#cc0000"
  )) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Opioid"    = "#007acc",
    "All-drug"  = "#00b050",
    "All-cause" = "#cc0000"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Opioid vs All-Drug vs All-Cause Age-Adjusted Mortality 2000–2020",
    x = "Year",
    color = "Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(margin = margin(l = 10))
  )

opioid_vs_drug_vs_all
#opioid_vs_drug
```
